title: Revert the Card atom to privately use Ant Design's Card
objective: The owner explicitly asked to change card.tsx to use antd's Card, overriding the dependency-free design from UI-003. Reimplement CardView with antd's Card while keeping the public CardProps contract in index.ts unchanged, so EntitySummary and every other consumer are unaffected.
risks: CardProps and the Card() function signature do not change, so the public API declaration and its tracked baseline are expected to stay identical; api-check still runs to confirm no antd type leaks now that antd is imported again.
Per DEC-053/ADR-0015, this task prepares uncommitted changes only; the repository owner reviews and creates the actual Git commit.
